name: Slidebootor – Slider Widget for Elementor
author: samiur6688

sections.description:
Slidebootor – Slider Widget for Elementor adds a flexible and responsive slider widget to Elementor, allowing you to build modern hero sections and image carousels without writing code.

The widget is built on Bootstrap 4 carousel structure and integrates seamlessly with Elementor editor for live preview editing. You can create unlimited slides using repeater fields, each with its own background image or color, title, description, and optional button.

It also includes powerful customization options such as global or per-slide overlays, navigation controls, autoplay settings, typography controls, and styling options.

Features:

  • Create multiple slides using Elementor repeater controls.
  • Add background images or solid background colors per slide.
  • Add title and description for each slide.
  • Optional call-to-action button for each slide.
  • Customize button text, link, background color, and hover color.
  • Global overlay support for all slides.
  • Per-slide overlay override option.
  • Show or hide navigation arrows.
  • Show or hide indicator dots.
  • Enable or disable autoplay with interval control.
  • Adjustable slide height (px or vh).
  • Typography controls for title and description.
  • Fully responsive Bootstrap-based layout.
  • Live preview support in Elementor editor.

How It Works:

The widget generates a Bootstrap carousel dynamically based on your slide settings. Each slide is rendered with its own background, content, and optional overlay. JavaScript handles autoplay and navigation using Bootstrap’s native carousel system.

Credits

Bootstrap 4.6.2

Source: https://getbootstrap.com

License: MIT License
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/slidebootor-slider-widget-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Open Elementor editor.
  5. Search for Slider or find it under the Slidebootor category.
  6. Drag and drop the widget into your page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated to use this widget.

Can each slide have its own image?

Yes. Each slide supports its own background image or color.

Does it support live preview in Elementor editor?

Yes. All changes are reflected instantly in the Elementor editor.

Can I use different overlay colors per slide?

Yes. You can set a global overlay or override it per slide.
